item.title: Spotify shares slide 7% amid tech sell-off, down over 23% in 2026
item.description: Spotify’s stock continued its decline on 5 February, falling more than 7% to close just above $440, extending losses to over 23% for 2026. The fall comes amid a broader sell-off in technology shares, which saw the Nasdaq index drop 1.51% on the day. The streaming giant’s stock has now reversed the gains it achieved during 2025, when shares peaked at $785 in June, following a period of strong market performance. item.title: Deezer Next programme returns in 2026 with new artists
item.description: Deezer has confirmed the return of its Deezer Next programme in 2026, continuing its support for emerging artists in the French-speaking music scene. The initiative is aimed at providing selected artists with increased visibility and developmental support both on the streaming platform and through external opportunities. item.title: Training for an industry that does not wait
item.description: By Dr Sheldon Rocha Leal It is difficult for education to keep pace with an industry, like the entertainment sector, that is constantly evolving. item.description: By Tshifhiwa Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo Zimbabwean-born artist manager Malackcean Gwayi has built a career managing a wide range of established and emerging artists across Southern Africa. item.title: Maleh to launch Dithapelo album with live concert in Joburg
item.description: Lesotho-born singer and songwriter Maleh has announced a live album launch concert for her latest release, Dithapelo, scheduled to take place at Johannesburg’s Market Theatre on 28 March. The performance will mark the first full live presentation of Dithapelo, an album released in November 2025 that reflects themes of faith, reflection and spiritual renewal. item.title: SA: Hxdi Stross shares new single Nakwela
item.description: Pretoria-based artist and video producer Hxdi Stross has released a new single titled ‘Nakwela’, marking a shift in his musical direction and creative approach. item.title: TikTok plans shift to per-play Music pay-outs, according to industry sources
item.description: TikTok is preparing to revise its long-criticised music royalty payment system, with plans to introduce pay-outs based on the number of times a video is played rather than a single payment per video, according to information shared with Digital Music News (DMN). item.description: By Tshifhiwa Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo Nhlanhla Phiri, known professionally as DJY Spetla, is a South African DJ, producer and entrepreneur whose work spans music production, business and community initiatives. item.title: Ghanaian highlife legend Ebo Taylor dead at 90
item.description: Ghanaian highlife musician and composer Ebo Taylor died on 7 February at the age of 90. His family confirmed the news, although the cause of death had not been disclosed at the time of publication. Taylor’s passing comes six years after he received the Music In Africa Honorary Award at the opening of the Music In Africa Conference for Collaborations, Exchange and Showcases (ACCES) in Accra on 28 November 2019.
